embeds.title: 🔴 Shai-Hulud Worm Source Code Released; Multiple Supply Chain Incidents Reported
embeds.description:
**Actor:** TeamPCP
Individuals claiming to be associated with the TeamPCP hacking group released the source code of the Shai-Hulud worm on the Breached[.]st forum. The worm was previously used in a supply chain attack that compromised the TanStack React framework and spread to almost 400 packages, including libraries at Mistral and UiPath. Datadog researchers confirmed the worm's authenticity. The article reports that OpenAI was impacted by the TanStack incident, with two employees affected by the Mini Shai-Hulud worm; OpenAI confirmed malicious activity on employee devices but stated the intrusion was limited and did not access user data. The source code release is expected to spawn additional attacks against GitHub repositories and developer ecosystems.
**Sources:** Risky Biz News • 🟡 2 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Supply chain attack via compromised npm and PyPI packages
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://news.risky.biz/risky-bulletin-shai-hulud-goes-open-source/)
